text:
alexandra: Following the postmortem, we need a concise action tracker for the recurring vendor auth/model-registry outages. Observed pattern: short auth service degradations cascade to model-registry reads and then to client timeouts. Proposing owners + minimal timelines in this thread.

rishi: I'll take the cross-service retry strategy and circuit-breaker policy. Deliverable: spec + PR to infra-clients repo. ETA: 72h. Plan: per-endpoint retry budgets, jittered backoff, and a 95th-pct observability dashboard.

emily: I'll own the model-registry token refresh path + automated integration test in staging. Need infra to enable KMS access in staging before I can validate. ETA: 5 days after KMS access.

ben: Security will rotate the vendor integration secrets immediately and add a GH action to run a smoke test post-rotation. I'll post the rotation ticket. ETA: rotation in 24h, GH action in 48h.

caroline: PM note 1: I'll prepare customer communication templates and a FAQ for SRE to reference. Also adding a short blurb for the status page with impact tiers. ETA: 3 business days.

infra-bot: DEPLOYMENT: infra-auth-client v2.4.1 rolled to staging at 2026-09-15T03:21:00Z (rollout-id: r-9982).

alexandra: Two extra asks: (1) quick local fallback for read-only model lookups during auth flaps, and (2) vendor SLA review + alternate auth vendor evaluation. Who can own these?

rishi: I can prototype the fallback gating logic. Sketch below:

```
if (auth_latency > 1s && retries_exhausted) {
  if (cache.has(valid_manifest)) return cache.get();
  if (local_light_model_available) return local_model_lookup();
  emit('fallback_miss');
}
```

emily: For the vendor SLA review, put that on my plate as well  I'll compile incident frequency, MTTR, and error-class distribution for the last 12 months and propose threshold-based escalation rules. ETA: 1 week.

ben: Security also requests automated smoke test that 1) uses rotated secret 2) exercises token refresh path 3) validates KV caches are invalidated. Need GH issue link.

alexandra: I'll create the GH issue INC-2026-Auth-Followups and attach owners/timelines after this thread. Please include the ticket number in comments below once created.

caroline: One more product ask: include a customer opt-in toggle for stronger consistency (uses warmer paths with slightly higher latency) while we harden the auth path. Can we scope quickly?

rishi: That would be a config flag on the model service. I can add a design note; ETA: 1 sprint to implement and QA.

emily: Staging KMS is the gating item for my work. infra team, can we get that provisioned today?

infra-bot: TICKET: infra#6742 created for staging KMS access. ETA estimated: 48 hours.

alexandra: Good. For recurring-pattern remediation: recommend a quarterly vendor reliability review, plus a monthly short health-check dashboard for auth/model-registry error classes (5m rollups). Assigning emily to the quarterly report and rishi to the dashboard.

ben: Security sets a hard 48-hour rotation window for high-risk vendor tokens and will automate it. We'll also require smoke test success before closing rotations.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT:INC-2026-45-FOLLOWUP created (link: github.com/redwood/infra/issues/4342). Reminder set for 72h.

alexandra: Thanks. Action summary (brief):
- rishi: retry/circuit-breaker + dashboard (72h)
- emily: token refresh tests + quarterly SLA report (5d + 7d)
- ben: secret rotation + GH action (24-48h)
- caroline: customer comms + status page copy (3d)
- alexandra: create GH issue + runbook section (today)

alexandra: If anyone needs to adjust ETA, reply here. I'll post the GH issue and link it to the postmortem doc in 1 hour.

(End of thread)
